title: The Great Wall of China: Construction History
text: The Great Wall of China was constructed over many centuries by various Chinese dynasties, with the most extensive building occurring during the Ming dynasty (1368–1644). The wall stretches approximately 21,196 km in total length when all sections are counted. It was built primarily using rammed earth, tamped earth, stone, and brick, depending on the region and era. Construction required enormous labor, and many workers died during building; they were often buried within the wall itself according to legend. The wall served primarily as a military fortification and signal communication system, using beacon towers to relay messages using fire and smoke.
